command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== step: install quota tools =="
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
sudo -n apt-get update -qq
sudo -n apt-get install -y -qq quota quotatool >/tmp/apt-install.log 2>&1 || { cat /tmp/apt-install.log; exit 1; }
dpkg -l | grep -E '^ii\s+quota' || true

echo "== step: create backing image for /srv/data =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/data
sudo -n fallocate -l 512M /var/lib/srvdata.img || sudo -n dd if=/dev/zero of=/var/lib/srvdata.img bs=1M count=512
sudo -n mkfs.ext4 -q -F /var/lib/srvdata.img
IMG_UUID=$(sudo -n blkid -s UUID -o value /var/lib/srvdata.img)
echo "img uuid: $IMG_UUID"

echo "== step: fstab entry =="
sudo -n cp /etc/fstab /etc/fstab.bak.disk-quota
if ! grep -q '/srv/data' /etc/fstab; then
  echo "/var/lib/srvdata.img /srv/data ext4 loop,rw,usrquota,relatime 0 0" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab >/dev/null
fi
cat /etc/fstab | grep srv

echo "== step: mount =="
sudo -n mount /srv/data
mount | grep '/srv/data'

echo "== step: create datauser =="
sudo -n useradd -M -s /usr/sbin/nologin datauser || true
id datauser

echo "== step: enable quota on filesystem =="
sudo -n quotacheck -cmug /srv/data || true
sudo -n quotaon /srv/data
quotaon -p /srv/data || true

echo "== step: set 100MB quota for datauser =="
sudo -n setquota -u datauser 102400 102400 0 0 /srv/data
sudo -n repquota -u /srv/data | grep -E 'datauser|Block'

echo "== step: fix ownership so datauser can write =="
sudo -n chown root:root /srv/data
sudo -n chmod 1777 /srv/data
ls -ld /srv/data
